semantic_meaning: Marks the stop-point in a dependency tree: where control consolidates and downstream becomes constrained.
when_to_use: When a dependency graph must end at a specific control boundary
When explaining why upstream determines downstream outcomes
When highlighting the 'last node that matters' for leverage
when_not_to_use: To end a graph arbitrarily without justification
If the stop-point is not tied to a leverage/control claim

animation_behavior.description: Tree grows in cyan; traversal animates; at stop-point the amber marker locks and traversal stops with an explicit boundary label.

state_beats.label: stop_lock
state_beats.meaningful_change: Amber stop marker locks at stop node.

state_beats.label: boundary_callout
state_beats.meaningful_change: Boundary label appears; motion stops deliberately.

expected_outputs: A dependency tree with an explicit stop-point and leverage marker
validation_notes: Stop-point must be justified by the narrative; amber is never decorative.
